description: Repo-patchable workflow remediation cases for local proof runs. Each case overwrites a vulnerable fixture path with a defended workflow body from this repository, then expects the native workflow-security findings for that path to drop to zero.

cases.rationale: Replace inherited default write authority on a low-trust trigger with explicit read-only permissions and an actor gate.
Replace privileged checkout of attacker-controlled pull-request head with a trusted base checkout plus read-only permissions.
Replace privileged download-execute without integrity binding with a checksum-verified flow under read-only token permissions.
